notablePrerequisites:
Gossip's Talent is level 3.
[creature] doesn't have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exchange of Words enters, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of itself and Wormfang Manta.
Declare the creature you wish to blink as an attacker, attacking an opponent that cannot block it.
When that creature deals damage, Gossip's Talent's last ability triggers, blinking Exchange of Words.
When Exchange of Words leaves the battlefield, its ability from Wormfang Manta's textbox triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
When Exchange of Words enters, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of itself and Wormfang Manta.
Repeat from step 3 each turn.
